default_sender.description: Email address used as the default sender when none is specified.

relay_host.description: Hostname or IP of the SMTP relay server (leave empty for direct delivery).

relay_port.description: Port number of the SMTP relay server.

relay_auth.description: Enable authentication to the relay host.

relay_user.description: Username for relay authentication (only used if relay_auth=true).

allowed_networks.description: Networks (CIDR or hostnames) allowed to submit mail without restriction.

local_hosts.description: Hosts treated as local (mail for these is delivered locally, not relayed).

max_connections_per_host.description: Maximum concurrent SMTP connections per remote host.

max_message_size.description: Maximum message size in bytes (0 = unlimited).

use_tls.description: Enable STARTTLS for outbound SMTP connections.

tls_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS verification.

dns_lookup.description: Enable DNS MX lookups to determine delivery targets.

retry_interval.description: Seconds between delivery retries for deferred messages.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of delivery attempts before bouncing the message.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity (debug, info, notice, warn, err, crit, alert, emerg).

log_file.description: Path to log file (use '-' for stdout).

queue_dir.description: Directory used for the message queue.

pid_file.description: File to store the DMA daemon process ID.

listen.description: Addresses/ports to listen on for incoming SMTP.

submission_auth.description: Authentication method for the submission port (587).

ldap_uri.description: LDAP server URI for submission auth (only if submission_auth=ldap).

ldap_bind_dn.description: Bind DN for LDAP submission auth (if not anonymous bind).

items.description: An alias mapping localpart to one or more targets.

value.description: Delivery targets (usernames, addresses, or file paths).

items.description: A mailbox, email address, or file path (e.g., root, admin@example.com, /var/mail/logs).
Map a sender address pattern to a replacement.

from.description: Pattern or exact sender address to match (e.g., user@example.com or @example.com).

items.description: Map a recipient address pattern to a replacement.

from.description: Pattern or exact recipient address to match.
